hypothesis: Head and stem effects and interaction may differ when exact and detected background similarity no longer cross evaluation boundaries.

mechanism_control.scope: exploratory development only; output density, stride, DFL range, initialization and raw parameter count matched, effective capacity differs

checkpoint: epoch50 EMA, no checkpoint or model selection

split.selection: Data-only randomized assignments. Large groups go to train. Other groups have probabilities [0.5,0.25,0.25]. Minimize squared deviations from target fractions in image, UAV-box, Bird-box and tiny-UAV counts, equally weighted. First minimum wins; no AP used.

evaluation_freeze: All four factorial configurations and all 12 terminal checkpoint hashes frozen before any new test inference. Development inference may diagnose execution but cannot choose a checkpoint or variant. No final-test-guided tuning.
interpretation: Background matching proxies cannot establish true scene or sequence independence. All SIRST images were historically available; this is a new matched robustness experiment, not a pristine external test.
uncertainty: Report all three paired seeds, mean, sample SD and descriptive paired t interval; seed interval measures training randomness only. Also report background-group clustered sensitivity when sufficient groups exist.
